legend: Mikhail walks on a Cartesian plane. He starts at the point (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$, and in one move he can go to any of eight adjacent points. For example, if Mikhail is currently at the point (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$, he can go to any of the following points in one move:
If Mikhail goes from the point (x1,y1)$$$(x1, y1)$$$ to the point (x2,y2)$$$(x2, y2)$$$ in one move, and x1≠x2$$$x1 \ne x2$$$ and y1≠y2$$$y1 \ne y2$$$, then such a move is called a diagonal move.

Mikhail has q$$$q$$$ queries. For the i$$$i$$$-th query Mikhail's target is to go to the point (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$ from the point (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ in exactly ki$$$k_i$$$ moves. Among all possible movements he want to choose one with the maximum number of diagonal moves. Your task is to find the maximum number of diagonal moves or find that it is impossible to go from the point (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ to the point (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$ in ki$$$k_i$$$ moves.
Note that Mikhail can visit any point any number of times (even the destination point!).
input: The first line of the input contains one integer q$$$q$$$ (1≤q≤104$$$1 \le q \le 10^4$$$) — the number of queries.

Then q$$$q$$$ lines follow. The i$$$i$$$-th of these q$$$q$$$ lines contains three integers ni$$$n_i$$$, mi$$$m_i$$$ and ki$$$k_i$$$ (1≤ni,mi,ki≤1018$$$1 \le n_i, m_i, k_i \le 10^{18}$$$) — x$$$x$$$-coordinate of the destination point of the query, y$$$y$$$-coordinate of the destination point of the query and the number of moves in the query, correspondingly.
output: Print q$$$q$$$ integers. The i$$$i$$$-th integer should be equal to -1 if Mikhail cannot go from the point (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ to the point (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$ in exactly ki$$$k_i$$$ moves described above. Otherwise the i$$$i$$$-th integer should be equal to the the maximum number of diagonal moves among all possible movements.
note: One of the possible answers to the first test case: (0,0)→(1,0)→(1,1)→(2,2)$$$(0, 0) \to (1, 0) \to (1, 1) \to (2, 2)$$$.
In the third test case Mikhail cannot reach the point (10,1)$$$(10, 1)$$$ in 9 moves.

legend.ai: Mikhail 在笛卡尔平面上行走。他从点 (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ 出发，每次移动可以走到八个相邻点中的任意一个。例如，如果 Mikhail 当前在点 (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$，他可以在一次移动中到达以下任意一个点：
如果 Mikhail 在一次移动中从点 (x1,y1)$$$(x1, y1)$$$ 移动到点 (x2,y2)$$$(x2, y2)$$$，且 x1≠x2$$$x1 \ne x2$$$ 且 y1≠y2$$$y1 \ne y2$$$，那么这种移动称为对角移动。

Mikhail 有 q$$$q$$$ 个查询。在第 i$$$i$$$ 个查询中，Mikhail 的目标是从点 (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ 出发，恰好经过 ki$$$k_i$$$ 次移动到达点 (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$。在所有可能的移动方案中，他希望选择对角移动次数最多的方案。你的任务是求出对角移动的最大次数，或者判定无法在 ki$$$k_i$$$ 次移动内从点 (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ 到达点 (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$。
注意，Mikhail 可以访问任意点任意多次（甚至包括终点！）。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 q$$$q$$$(1≤q≤104$$$1 \le q \le 10^4$$$)——查询的数量。
接下来是 q$$$q$$$ 行。其中这 q$$$q$$$ 行中的第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含三个整数 ni$$$n_i$$$、mi$$$m_i$$$ 和 ki$$$k_i$$$(1≤ni,mi,ki≤1018$$$1 \le n_i, m_i, k_i \le 10^{18}$$$)，分别表示查询目标点的 x$$$x$$$ 坐标、查询目标点的 y$$$y$$$ 坐标以及查询中的移动次数。

output.ai: 输出 q$$$q$$$ 个整数。如果 Mikhail 无法在上述定义的恰好 ki$$$k_i$$$ 步内从点 (0,0)$$$(0, 0)$$$ 到达点 (ni,mi)$$$(n_i, m_i)$$$，则第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数应为 -1。否则，第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数应等于所有可能移动方案中对角移动次数的最大值。

note.ai: 在第三组测试用例中，Mikhail 无法在 9 步内到达点 (10,1)$$$(10, 1)$$$。
